title: From Gaussian to Gumbel: extreme eigenvalues of complex Ginibre products with exact rates
summary: We consider the product of \(k_{n}\) independent \(n\times n\) complex Ginibre matrices and denote its eigenvalues by \(Z_{1},\ldots ,Z_{n}\). Let \(α= \lim_{n\to\infty} n / k_{n}\). Using the determinantal point process method, we reduce the study of extremal eigenvalues to the evaluation of determinants of certain \(n\times n\) matrices. In the modulus case, rotational invariance makes the relevant matrix diagonal, which yields a product representation in terms of Gamma tail probabilities.
